capability: Determine whether the actor independently established correspondence between the submitted preview and a fresh export of the delivered project. This unit measures comparison evidence only.
one: Actual independent re-export with sufficient evidence that submitted preview corresponds to it across the relevant rendering/state scope. Complete corresponding state records plus rendering inputs, images/decoded pixels, or equally sufficient independent observations are accepted. Two exports can establish the same relation through comprehensive independent invariants; no literal left==right statement, dedicated script, second-command count or file/hash syntax is mandatory. Both matching state and sufficient actual rendering/artwork/presentation evidence matter. Correct comparisons exposing mismatches also earn verification credit.
half: Useful actual current-preview correctness/API observations, or two captures with independently checked shared endpoints/counts/events or other partial invariants, but a material part of their intermediate state/artwork/presentation correspondence remains unestablished. Identify that concrete unverified scope. A single successful capture plus strong current-state checks earns partial credit, not zero. If actual independent invariant/rendering observations really establish the relevant complete relation, give full credit.
zero: No substantive observed capture/correspondence evidence, only self-authored PASS flags, or complete empty delivery. Unread or materially truncated evidence is unknown/null, never zero.
scope_boundary: Public producer-command usability, HOME/XDG setup and default-user startup are separately executed and scored. They MUST NOT lower or raise this comparison-only completion. An actor may have fully compared two correct captures while failing to document the environment needed by the receiver. Conversely an executable public recipe alone does not prove the actor performed an independent comparison. Capture-model claims, world-heading/timing correctness and public API regression are separately owned and are not regraded here.
equivalences: Accept a documented CPU/state producer and original client paragraph12 without a repeated GPU disclaimer. Different PNG encoding can preserve decoded pixels. Authentic independent image views, state calculations and producer/input correspondence may jointly prove the relation without an explicit automated diff. No preferred tool or retained filename.
source: Supplied preview-delivery-validation skill and handover-evidence reference teach independently re-exporting the delivered project and comparing corresponding state/media; user authorized production-ready verifiable handover and reasonable industry consensus. No scoring for reading a skill.
